Trump Imposes Tariffs on Drone Imports to Boost US Production

The Trump administration has announced tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and their components. Larger, sensitive drones will face a 100% levy, while smaller models will be subject to a 25% tariff. The stated aim is to encourage domestic production, reduce reliance on foreign supply chains, and counter China's influence in the drone market. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick noted the U.S. is "too reliant" on foreign unmanned aircraft systems and their parts. The White House stated the tariffs will "encourage increased domestic production" and reduce reliance on foreign supply chains.
